blocks.text: NBA superstar LeBron James sued the makers of an AI sports-betting app Tuesday, saying they have deliberately violated his publicity rights and trademarks by calling it “Bron” and using artificially generated images of him in their marketing. In a lawsuit filed in U.S. District Court in New York, James’ attorneys called it “a willful, bad-faith tactic” to use the player’s fame, likeness and nickname to promote “a new and unknown product.” READ: LeBron James moves to 3rd on NBA career assist list The complaint asks the court to block the makers from using the Philadelphia 76ers star’s name, to give up […]...
